operator_protocol.session_policy: fresh isolated session for each scenario, in matrix order
operator_protocol.upload_policy: for each scenario, upload all six absolute fixture paths in one filechooser call through the visible label before sending its frozen prompt
operator_protocol.prompt_policy: the operator types exactly the frozen scenario prompt; the app may append analysis-file lines for the six frozen uploads in arrival order, so record the exact submitted message and its digest from each session; any other input change stops the batch
operator_protocol.failure_policy: record ordinary case failures and continue; stop immediately on Provider/accounting failure, isolation failure, incomplete event transport, or first empty visible final output; record finish_reason when available
operator_protocol.mutation_policy: no code, contract, prompt, fixture, oracle, model, endpoint, budget, or ledger changes after freeze; no retries or partial reruns
operator_protocol.publication_policy: typed trial only; formal default and Shadow publication effect remain unchanged
